# Security Policy

## Supported version

Security fixes are made against the current `main` branch and the production
website and Android release built from it. Older commits and superseded APKs are
not supported.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Please do not disclose a suspected vulnerability in a public issue, discussion,
pull request, or social-media post.

Use GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/Deadlywolf712/dance-library/security/advisories/new)
whenever it is available. Include:

- the affected URL, release, or commit;
- clear reproduction steps or a minimal proof of concept;
- the security impact and any prerequisites;
- whether the issue is already public; and
- a safe way to contact you for follow-up.

Do not include live credentials, personal information, or unredacted sensitive
data. Redacted screenshots and test accounts are preferred.

If the private form is unavailable, use a private contact method listed on
[@Deadlywolf712's GitHub profile](https://github.com/Deadlywolf712). If no private
method is listed, open a minimal issue asking for a private security contact
channel without including technical details.

We aim to acknowledge a report within seven days and provide an initial
assessment within fourteen days. These are targets rather than guaranteed
service levels. Please allow a reasonable remediation window before publishing
details.
